hidden.reason: This is how the chat panel sends what a person types, so the assistant is already in the middle of it.

hidden.reason: Sends the graph editor's low-level edits with revision numbers; only the editor screen calls it.

hidden.reason: Policy proposals belong to the older recording pipeline and are approved on its screen, not by words.

hidden.reason: Subflows are being retired, so a person asks about the Flow's steps instead of its Subflows.

hidden.name: automation-studio__capture-client-snapshot
hidden.reason: This is sent between FluxIQ and a connected browser to capture a page; only a client process uses it.

hidden.name: automation-studio__clear-reusable-llm-context-scope
hidden.reason: Cache maintenance the runtime does itself, not a person's request.

hidden.name: automation-studio__compile-flow-source
hidden.reason: Sent by the code editor when it saves a Flow's source text; a person edits the Flow in words or steps.

hidden.name: automation-studio__convert-flow-to-visual
hidden.reason: A one-time conversion button in the code editor; not something a person asks the assistant for.

hidden.name: automation-studio__create-flow-subflow
hidden.reason: Subflows are being retired, so a person asks about the Flow's steps instead of its Subflows.
